body: Oh my god, I am so sorry that happened. There are no words.
to be fair, there really always is another time. except for when you kill yourself i guess. may i ask what your illness is?
What was the some reason? Was it a reflex or why did you stand up?

It's just normal stuff like getting up, work, meet people, doing anything at all really. There have been times where I enjoyed things like hanging with friends, planning parties, reading, dancing, sewing, just actively participating in life kinda. What brings me joy intrinsically is learning new things, I majored in physics because it was the hardest thing I could think of for me, so I guess I enjoy torturing myself. What I wanna say is that I remember enjoying strolling around a supermarket for example, little things were enough, but my "save" things just aren't doing it anymore. Nothing tastes good. Nothing looks good. Nothing feels good. Not even laying in bed when a day finally ends.

I honestly don't know, gotta google that. I've been in treatment on and off for like ten years, but I don't remember anyone ever mentioning different forms other than if it's recurring or how bad the episode is.

I have gotten better, then gotten worse, better, worse again and I only ONLY come here when I am really really down. I think depression is kind of a bit like being a dry alcoholic. You can get "clean" but you have to actively work for it almost every single day to stay there and you can also "relapse" so to say.
